note: bút danh specifically means a pen name. Bí danh is a general alias or pseudonym and fits fictional names used by writers or movie stars.
thoa usually means applying a substance by rubbing. Chà is the general Vietnamese verb for rubbing or scrubbing with pressure and friction.
杯 and cúp are suitable terms for a trophy shaped like an oversized cup.
弾道 is limited to a projectile's trajectory. 軌道 is the general word for a trajectory or path through space; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1223980 sense 0.
固まる usually means to harden or become solid and only fits gathering in a clump. 集まる means gather or assemble; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1333550 sense 0.
The supplied English sense is adjectival, despite the noun POS label. 国立 means national or run by the central government; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1287180 sense 0.
助かる directly covers being saved or rescued and surviving, which is the stated sense.
自慢 is usually self-praise or boasting. 慢心 means self-conceit or pride and better matches the unreasonable superiority in the definition; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1641050 sense 0.
衝立 is a standard physical partition screen used to block a view or provide separation, matching the stated object sense.
裁き suggests a formal verdict or moral judgment. 判断 is the general act of judging or making a decision; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1478620 sense 0.
chức vô địch is the champion's title, not the competition. Giải vô địch is the natural Vietnamese term for a championship competition.
hộp is a general box or container. Lon is the common Vietnamese word for a metal can, matching this tin container.
史家 is literary and uncommon, and nhà viết sử is descriptive. 歴史家 is the standard Japanese historian term, verified in JMdict ent_seq 1558070 sense 0; nhà sử học is the natural Vietnamese equivalent.
匂う usually suggests a pleasant smell. The kana におう can represent both pleasant and unpleasant senses in JMdict ent_seq 1599780 senses 0 and 1, matching the neutral English definition.
ディッシュ is a less common loanword for a specific prepared dish. 料理 is the natural general Japanese word for a prepared food or dish; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1554310 sense 0.

弦 and dây mean an instrument string, but the supplied English definition says a stringed instrument. The definition and translations describe different things, so the candidate cannot be promoted as written.
お守り covers a physical amulet, while the definition also includes a magical act or words. No single verified Japanese equivalent covers all parts of this combined definition.
四半 is a valid, dictionary-verified noun for a quarter or fourth; it is more formal than the common phrase 四分の一.
相手 has a standard opponent sense, including in sports, and fits one who opposes another in context.
フラッシュ often means a camera flash. 閃光 is a sudden flash or glint of light; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1392490 sense 0.
空き瓶 is limited to an empty bottle, while the English noun can be any empty container. I found no verified broader Japanese equivalent for the noun sense.
幼年 usually means early childhood or infancy. 子供時代 covers childhood more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2761990 sense 0.
sự cứu is an awkward nominalization here. Cuộc giải cứu is a natural Vietnamese noun for a rescue act or episode.
付き添う directly covers accompanying or attending someone as a companion, and fits the stated sense.
つかむ is the ordinary verb for grabbing or clutching something; a successful grasp is the normal reading of this verb.
sự ôm is understandable but unnatural for the concrete act or embrace. Cái ôm is the common Vietnamese noun for a hug.
積み重ね suggests an orderly or abstract accumulation. 山積み means a heap or pile; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1755720 sense 0.
被災者 specifically means a disaster victim. 被害者 means a person harmed or victimized more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1484370 sense 0.
犠牲者 often implies a casualty or someone killed. 被害者 means a person who is harmed; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1484370 sense 0.

犠牲 can mean sacrifice or casualty. 生贄 means a living sacrifice or sacrificial victim; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1830690 senses 0 and 1. Vật tế specifies the sacrificial offering rather than an offering in general.
マウス and chuột are standard contextual terms for a computer mouse; the supplied Japanese animal gloss does not change the computing sense.
The English sense is an adverb, despite the packet's noun POS. 先だって is an adverb meaning the other day or recently.
交わす usually means exchanging or crossing reciprocally. 交わる means intersect or cross geometrically; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1271700 sense 0.
死体 is a general dead body and often refers to humans. 死骸 is the standard term for an animal carcass; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1594130 sense 0.
sự tóm tắt means summary and is too narrow. Sự viết tắt is the Vietnamese noun for shortening or abbreviation.
練る can mean kneading or mixing into a paste more broadly. こねる is directly glossed to knead and is the common verb for working dough; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1567410 sense 0.
娯楽 is a standard noun for amusement, recreation, entertainment, or pastime and fits something done to pass time agreeably.
sự nói mỉa is an unnatural Vietnamese nominalization. Lời mỉa mai is a natural noun phrase for a sarcastic or contemptuous remark.
勇ましい covers bravery but not the courteous-to-women nuance in this combined definition; 紳士的 covers courtesy but not bravery. No single verified Japanese adjective covers both.
おとなしい has a standard docile or obedient sense and fits yielding to control or supervision.
